description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Amendment to the Ex-Ord. Gaz. No. 2001/02 of 09.01.2017 as the Motor Traffic (Motor Tricycle) Regulations, No. 01 of 2017 shall come into operation on 01.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Motor Traffic Act, specifically amending the Motor Traffic (Motor Tricycle) Regulations. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and modifications to existing regulations, not government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
